verdict.rationale: Qapita's own docs say it manages stock option plans "globally" and handles equity administration "across jurisdictions". That is a thin first-party claim covering only the international option-plan half of the story. Its valuation offering is described only as 409A, and IFRS/Ind AS expense reporting is a different capability from non-US valuations or schemes. missing for 10: UK HMRC/EMI valuation support, any non-US valuation service, named country-specific plan types (e.g. EMI, CSOP), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, non-US valuations and schemes — UK HMRC/EMI valuations, country-specific option plans — are supported for my international entities

citations.quote: Set up and manage stock option plans, grants, vesting, and exercises globally.
Qapita simplifies equity administration across jurisdictions
